evals.prompt: This is a small shop codebase organized by technical layer. Add a refund for an existing order: take an order id and amount, mark the order refunded, and expose it so an HTTP handler can call it. Implement it in this project. Do not rewrite unrelated files.
evals.expected_output: New refund code lands in a business slice (e.g. refunds/ or orders/) next to a colocated test, not under controllers/, services/, models/, or utils/. Existing layered files untouched.
expectations: New refund files live under a business slice path after src/ (orders, refunds, or similar), not under src/controllers, src/services, src/models, or src/utils
No new directory named controllers, services, models, handlers, helpers, or utils was created
The refund use case is not split across the technical layers — its logic lives in one colocated business-slice location
Existing layered files were not rewritten as part of adding refund

evals.prompt: Add Stripe card charging to checkout payment. The Stripe SDK may be stubbed.

src/checkout/payment/charge.ts has no Stripe SDK import, Stripe types, or provider === stripe branching
